validity.recommendation: Change LengthKnown from 190 to 240 km (half of the 480 km Package-8 total, matching the halving convention used on P6719-P6726); apply same fix to sibling P6727 ("3"). Cite MEED + BlackRidge.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION/OWNER all CONFIRM. P6728 is the "4" (EWGP-4) parallel line of Package 8 (EWPS-8 to EWPS-10) of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3) - a real, under-construction 56-inch dry-gas East-West transmission trunk, start/completion Q4 2028, Aramco 100%. Two fully independent sources describe it: MEED (the GEM-cited contractor-award article: 'Package 8: 480 km from EWPS-8 to EWPS-10', 56-inch) and BlackRidge Research ('Lay 56-inch diameter pipelines (EWGP-3 and EWGP-4) from EWPS-8 to EWPS-10 (480 km)'). Pipeline-journal.net independently notes a '241-kilometer pipeline section' on the same MGS Package 8 work, ~= one of the two parallel lines. Not an NGL/gathering/feeder line (it is a 56-in MGS trunk). Not a duplicate of another PID: it is the legitimate 2nd parallel line, distinct from sibling P6727 (the "3"/EWGP-3 line). SPEC CONFLICT on length: GEM splits each EWPS package into a "3" and a "4" row at HALF the package total (P6719/P6720 = 150+150 = 300 for Pkg4's 300 km; P6721/P6722 = 83+83 = 166 for Pkg5; P6723/P6724 = 185+185 = 370 for Pkg6; P6725/P6726 = 170+170 = 340 for Pkg7 - all exact halves). For Package 8 (480 km) the same convention requires 240 km per line, but GEM records P6727 and P6728 at 190 km each (380 km total), which matches NO source and breaks the project's own halving pattern - it appears to be off by ~50 km per line (240 vs 190). The pipeline-journal '241 km' figure independently supports ~240 km for one EWPS-8->EWPS-10 line. Diameter 56 in, status construction, fuel Gas, type transmission, owner Aramco, start 2028 all corroborated and CONFIRMED.

fills.researcher_notes: Proposed CORRECTION not a blank-fill: GEM has 190 km. Sources give Package 8 total = 480 km (MEED, BlackRidge); under GEM's per-line halving convention (verified on P6719-P6726) each of the two parallel lines = 240 km. Sources state the 480 km PACKAGE total, not the 240 km per-line figure verbatim, so contains_value is false for the literal '240' token - hence UNRESOLVED rather than auto-applied; needs Baird's decision on whether to apply the halving (240) or some other split. Pipeline-journal '241 km section' supports ~240 km/line.

summary: P6728 is a real, correctly-classified 56-in MGS-3 gas transmission line (EWGP-4, EWPS-8->EWPS-10, Aramco, construction, 2028) - but its 190 km length conflicts with the 480 km Package-8 total (=240 km/line under GEM's own halving convention); spec concern, length correction proposed but left UNRESOLVED pending review.
